disable_wallpaper.label: Disable Wallpapers
disable_wallpaper.description: Tear down background surfaces to free GPU VRAM memory

disable_animations.label: Disable Animations
disable_animations.description: Turn off window and shell transition animations

hide_widgets.label: Hide Desktop Widgets
hide_widgets.description: Pause and hide all active desktop widgets

enable_dnd.label: Do Not Disturb
enable_dnd.description: Silence all notification toasts while active

clear_notifications.label: Dismiss Active Notifications
clear_notifications.description: Clear any currently visible notification toasts immediately

set_power_profile.label: Performance Power Profile
set_power_profile.description: Set CPU and system governor to Performance mode

hide_bar.label: Hide Status Bar
hide_bar.description: Hide Noctalia status bar for full screen immersion

hide_dock.label: Hide Dock
hide_dock.description: Hide Noctalia application dock while performance mode is active

disable_osd.label: Disable OSD Popups
disable_osd.description: Suppress volume and brightness popups to avoid game frame drops

pause_media.label: Pause Media Playback
pause_media.description: Pause background media players when entering performance mode

hook_on_enter.label: Enter Hook Command
hook_on_enter.description: Custom shell command or script executed when performance mode is enabled

hook_on_exit.label: Exit Hook Command
hook_on_exit.description: Custom shell command or script executed when performance mode is disabled
